svg.title: A12 STARDUST ISOTOPE FOUNDRY engineering architecture
svg.desc: Counts are mixed before ratios and before inference. Beam/background response and mass-fractionation covariance remain visible, preventing ratio averaging or nominal dilution from masquerading as source evidence.
